facts.fact: The official Spanish tourism map explicitly distinguishes the new gateway opened in 1512 under Archbishop Diogo de Sousa from the present monumental arch built in 1772/73.
facts.location: PDF page1, lower-left column, heading5 ARCO DA PORTA NOVA.

facts.fact: The enlarged historic-centre map places the Arco da Porta Nova, cathedral and Santa Bárbara Garden within the central walking area. Separate maps place Bom Jesus and Sameiro outside that compact group.
facts.location: PDF page1 enlarged-centre map and sanctuary inset; page2 wider location map.

notes: Actual HTTP200 PDF captured and SHA checked. Document has image-only pages; pdftotext returned no substantive text. Both pages were rendered locally with pdftoppm and visually read as JPEGs. No OCR or cached search snippet counted as reading. Only facts used; no copyrighted map graphics are served publicly.
